name: com.sca.in_telligent.openapi.service.BackgroundService
description: The In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK starts this Service during initialization; after the user removes the app from Recents, it clears the SDK's previous priority-alert state and stops itself.
disableEffect: Priority-alert state will not be cleared when the app is swiped away, so later alert handling may use stale state.
